filter.rule: Case-insensitive airstrike/air strike or attack on civilian(s) in Incident Tags or Incident Type.

tent_proximity.denominator: Filtered incidents with valid coordinates/date that match an available weekly tent file and fall inside that week's prediction-coverage polygon.
tent_proximity.tent_points_are: Detected tent point geometries in the corresponding weekly merged GPKG after canonical DBSCAN noise removal and time-valid yellow-line exclusion.

block_density_quintile_incident_rates.method: Block-weeks with zero raw detected tents form a separate no_tents category. Corrected tent density among tent-present block-weeks is divided into five global quintiles. Rates use summed covered block km2-weeks as exposure.

evacuation_direction_adjacent_block_inci.method: Incident counts are pooled across evacuation-order-direction events and classified by whether their adjacent block lies in the indicated half-plane. An incident can contribute to more than one association when orders/directions overlap.

t_evacuation_order_week.counting_unit: incident-order-direction association in an adjacent block

t_plus_1_following_week.counting_unit: incident-order-direction association in an adjacent block

t_and_t_plus_1_combined.counting_unit: incident-order-direction association in an adjacent block
